mapper.select: SELECT id, simulation_code, simulation_name, initiation_id, version, scenario_type, contract_amount, external_revenue, internal_cost, expected_hours, blended_rate, gross_profit, gross_margin, target_margin, labor_cost, purchase_cost, expense_cost, outsource_cost, assumptions, status, approver_name, approved_at, remark, applicant_id, applicant_name, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_profit_simulation WHERE simulation_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, simulation_code, simulation_name, initiation_id, version, scenario_type, contract_amount, external_revenue, internal_cost, expected_hours, blended_rate, gross_profit, gross_margin, target_margin, labor_cost, purchase_cost, expense_cost, outsource_cost, assumptions, status, approver_name, approved_at, remark, applicant_id, applicant_name, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_profit_simulation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM pmis_project_profit_simulation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0
